proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Reduce to the discrete valuation ring case by the base-change compatibility of the composition, work affinely using locality of the construction and compatibility of specialization with flat pullback, pull the first factor into the image of the cycle-classes construction over a completely decomposed proper cover, decompose the second cycle at the generic point into pushforwards along the cover using the envelope lemma and extend the pieces uniquely to relative cycles matching at the generic point by the uniqueness lemma, reduce by linearity and the push-pull formula for the composition to the pullback composition, further reduce by the discrete valuation ring version of the cover lemma and bilinearity to a single pair of flat cycle classes, and evaluate the composition by the closed-pair formula as the cycle class of the fibred product, flat of the sum relative dimension, which is a relative cycle by the specialization lemma for families of cycles associated to closed subschemes (source lines 3008-3061)
